text:
Alex Morales: Quick heads-up — EU hosted demand curve for chat APIs just moved up. Forecast shows ~28% q/q token growth and tails that’ll push into our reserved pool around mid-August. We should consider a short-term buffer-pool tune + more aggressive cross-region fallback before committing new capacity.
Priya Shah: Can you paste the forecast numbers? Do we hit hard or soft overcommit?
Alex Morales: Rough summary: baseline 220->282 active GPU-hours/day, p95 spikes at 360. Our committed pool in eu-west is ~320 GPU-hours/day effective (post-preemptions). Risk window ~Aug 10–25.
Priya Shah: OK running quick scenarios: conservative (no mitigation) = shortfall 40 GPUs on peak days; buffer + fallback = shortfall 8; temporary burst lease (cloud) = shortfall 0 but +20% cost on that window.
Marco Li: From billing side, burst leases at current spot+burst add ~€0.92/GPU-hour but they bill a minimum 24h on some SKUs. Need to confirm effective hourly vs reserved amortized cost.
Jenna Ortiz: Ops note — we can change the buffer pool size and routing policy without deploy: just update pool config in infra-config. Quick patch I tested in staging:
```
infractl pool update --region eu --name buffer --multiplier 1.15
infractl routing set --region eu --policy fallback-priority:us,eu-stable
```
If we schedule this 48h before expected peak it should shave peaks by ~10-15% latency-preserving cache hits.
ops-bot: [alert] Projected shortfall: 48 GPUs (eu-west) if no mitigations, projected date: 1717008000.
Marco Li: Also flagged: last month's committed utilization was 78% for the eu pool; if we re-route some long-tail embed bursts to us-west we recover ~12% effective capacity.
Priya Shah: Action items: 1) I'll run 3-run Monte Carlo with jitter and share numbers by EOD. 2) Marco to confirm burst SKU hourly effective price and minimum billing. 3) Jenna to prepare pool update script and rollback plan. 4) Ops to add a dashboard widget for buffer usage.
Jenna Ortiz: Will do. I'll put the config + runbook in the eng-infra channel and add a cron job to preemptively scale buffer during predicted peaks.
Alex Morales: If Monte Carlo shows >25 GPU shortfall persistently we should escalate to finance for a short-term committed add or re-allocate reserved from low-util teams.
FinanceBot: FYI — transferring reserved commitments between teams requires 7 days lead and approval. Temporary purchases can be negotiated, but pricing is subject to volume.
Marco Li: I'll check if any low-util reservations exist in the org and post a shortlist.
Priya Shah: thx. ping @SRE on the scheduled change once scripts are ready.
Jenna Ortiz: tagging: @SRE. Will post the changelog and do a dry-run during low traffic window tonight.
Alex Morales: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. Let's sync tomorrow 09:30 if Priya has runs.
